spans.s:
प्रु (ङ) प्रुङ् r. 1st cl. (प्रवते)
 1. To go, to move.
 2. To jump.

प्रुष r. 1st cl. (उ) प्रुषु (प्रोषति) To burn, to consume with fire. r. 9th cl.
(पुष्णाति) To be unctuous or bland.
 2. To sprinkle.
 3. To fill.
 4. To
set free.
 5. To be fond of or kind to.

प्रुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Burnt.
 E. प्रुष् to burn, aff. क्ता ।

प्रुष्व m. (-ष्वः)
 1. A season of the year, a period of two months.
 2. The
sun.
 f. (-ष्वा) A drop of water.
 E. प्रुष् to burn, Unādi aff. क्कन् ।
